exposure: women who did not intend to labor
cohort: Women undergoing delivery of twins at a single maternal-fetal medicine practice between January 2005 and February 2018 (n=788)
finding: In patients undergoing twin delivery, women who intend to labor have similar maternal morbidity compared with women who do not intend to labor.
mod_finding: Women who intended to labor vaginally had similar maternal morbidity compared with women who did not intend to labor vaginally in twin deliveries.
